items.text: The page title follows a 'Brand — tagline by person' pattern, and the document language is set to English.
items.evidence: facts.title = 'Never Skip Brunch — DIY & Home Design by Cara Newhart'; lang = 'en'; meta names are charset, viewport and description; jsonld

items.text: A full-width magenta announcement bar sits at the very top, with a promo phrase, a sparkle glyph and an underlined 'visit the shop →' link.

items.text: The header puts the logo image on the left and a horizontal nav of uppercase, letter-spaced sans-serif links on the right, ending in a 'MORE ▾' dropdown trigger.

items.text: The page uses a warm palette of cream, peach, butter yellow, near-black and hot pink. The pink accent is the only saturated colour besides the photos.
The CTA labels are lowercase and medium weight, and many end in an arrow glyph. The arrows are used consistently across buttons and text links.
items.evidence: 'browse all posts →', 'watch on youtube →', 'read the post →', 'the nsb shop →', 'visit the shop →'.

items.text: The banner's CTA is a white pill with dark text, inverted from the dark pills elsewhere. It sits below a short two-line paragraph.
items.evidence: 'wanna grab a virtual coffee?' white button. White-background elements count 26.

items.text: The Instagram section background is solid peach and ends with a dark pill 'follow on instagram'. Its header block is left-aligned and matches the blog section's eyebrow and heading pattern.
items.evidence: '@neverskipbrunch' eyebrow, h2 'on instagram'. Peach rgb(253,230,211)-like fill spans full width.

features.statement: Page title follows a 'Brand — tagline by person' pattern with English document language.
A full-width saturated accent-colored announcement bar at the top carries a short promo phrase and an underlined arrow link.
Header places a logo at left and uppercase, letter-spaced sans-serif nav links at right, ending in a dropdown trigger.
Logo is a raster stamp combining a serif wordmark, handwritten script byline and small circular emblem.
Page background is a warm off-white cream rather than pure white, with a slightly lighter header band.
Text color is a near-black warm charcoal rather than pure black.
Palette is warm: cream, peach, butter yellow, near-black, with one hot-pink saturated accent besides photos.
Typography combines a geometric sans for body, a handwritten script for accents, and a serif for headings.
Headings are very large, regular-weight serif, often italic, mostly lowercase, sometimes ending in a period.
Section headings are preceded by a small kicker line in accent-colored handwritten script.
Heading text mixes faces, with one word in accent-colored italic serif inside a roman heading.
Body copy is about 17px with generous line-height around 1.65.
Hero is a two-column split with text on one side and a tall portrait photo on the other.
Hero photo is masked into an arch shape with rounded bottom corners and a soft diffuse shadow.
Hero background is a soft vertical peach-to-cream gradient.
Buttons are fully rounded pills, as solid dark fills or thin outlines, often paired as primary and secondary CTAs.
Border radii avoid small values: corners are square, large rounded, or pill, never subtly rounded.
Content cards are white with borders and large rounded corners, with script lead-ins in the headings.
Ellipses are typed as spaced periods in headings.
A full-bleed 50/50 split section pairs a photo with a pale colored text panel.
Photography is color-styled to match the brand palette.
Post cards show a small pill category tag, serif title and accent text link, without thumbnail images.
Pagination uses circular numbered buttons with the active page filled black, plus a pill 'next' button.
A full-width photo band with dark overlay holds centered white serif italic text, script kicker and an inverted white pill button.
Decorative photos use empty alt attributes, and no image lacks alt.
Social-style cards keep an informal voice with all-caps phrases, hashtags and emoji.
Footer is a dark charcoal multi-column block with cream text.
Footer links carry small accent-colored sequence numbers after each label.
Footer has inline forms with white pill inputs and accent pill buttons.
Social links are white circular icon buttons using inline SVG.
Footer ends with a casual 'p.s.' affiliate disclosure in small muted text and a copyright line below a divider.
Heading hierarchy skips levels, with h4s directly after h2s.
Semantic landmarks are minimal, with no article, aside or figure elements even for post cards.
Page is link-dense, with many anchors relative to word count.
Class naming is compact and descriptive, not utility-framework style.
Layout uses both flexbox and grid, with flex more common.
Motion is limited to simple transitions, with no animations, transforms or backdrop blur.
Content sits in a centered container with wide side margins, while select bands run full-bleed.
Page is long, spanning several viewport heights.
Copy is casual and first-person, using ampersands and plus signs as conjunctions.
CTA labels are lowercase and medium weight, with trailing arrow glyphs used consistently.
A transparent pill-radius menu toggle exists but is hidden on desktop, indicating a mobile-only nav.
